description: This file defines types and structures related to resource replacements in the Kubernetes Kustomize project, including Replacement, SourceSelector, TargetSelector, and associated methods.

classes.name: Replacement
classes.description: Defines how to perform a substitution, specifying source and target fields.

classes.name: SourceSelector
classes.description: Represents the source of the replacement, including resource identification and field path.

classes.name: TargetSelector
classes.description: Specifies target fields in objects for the replacement, including selection and rejection criteria.

classes.name: TargetSelectorRegex
classes.description: Provides regex-based matching for target selectors.

classes.name: FieldOptions
classes.description: Refines interpretation of field paths, including delimiter, index, encoding, and creation options.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of SourceSelector.

methods.name: NewTargetSelectorRegex
methods.description: Creates a new TargetSelectorRegex from a TargetSelector.

methods.name: Selects
methods.description: Determines if a given resource ID matches the target selector.

methods.name: RejectsAny
methods.description: Checks if any resource ID in a list matches the reject criteria.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of FieldOptions.
